bias.en: Pullback · lost the $388 cap and 200-day, on $380
bias.zh: 回调 · 跌破 $388 上限和 200 日均线，位于 $380

read.en: Tesla fell 2.7% on Nov 16 to $379.74, trading $375.63–389.80. It is above the 100-day ($366.6), and just below the 10-day ($380.2), 30-day ($381.4, rising), 200-day ($382.5) and 5-day ($387.6). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, above zero, histogram widening again after nearly closing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 12 ($342.01), and RSI is 49.5.
read.zh: 特斯拉 11月16日下跌 2.7%，收于 $379.74，盘中区间 $375.63–389.80。股价位于 100 日均线（$366.6）上方，略低于 10 日（$380.2）、30 日（$381.4，上行）、200 日（$382.5）和 5 日均线（$387.6）。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴上方，柱状图在几乎收拢后再度放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月12日起看多（$342.01），RSI 为 49.5。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports ($379.8–388.6), including the $388 cap, now resistance; the close sits on the Nov 10 close ($379.78). Resistance is $380.2–382.5, then $385.2–389.8 ($388 cap, 5-day, Nov 16 high) and $397.5–401.2. Support is $375.5–375.6 (Nov 4 and 16 lows), then $366.6–370.4 (100-day, Nov 10 low) and $358–360 (Nov 6 close, Nov 9 low). A close above $382.5 would target $385–390; below $375.5, $366.6–370.4.
